name: Wei Song
bio_short: BSD Lab alum continuing his research training at the Donders Institute under Prof. Floris de Lange.
bio_long: Wei Song completed his master's training in cognitive neuroscience at South China Normal University, where he studied information transmission and large-scale brain network dynamics using sEEG and cortico-cortical evoked potentials. He is continuing his research training at the Donders Institute for Brain, Cognition and Behaviour under the supervision of Prof. Floris de Lange.
